bear.achieves_if: forward EPS misses by > 10% OR gross margin compression OR sector multiple de-rating
bear.achieves_if_text: forward EPS misses by > 10% OR gross margin compression OR sector multiple de-rating

achieves_if_struct.narrative: forward EPS misses by > 10% OR gross margin compression OR sector multiple de-rating

bear.invalidated_if: company beats guidance 2 quarters in a row WITH multiple holding > p50

base.achieves_if: earnings trajectory in-line with trend AND multiple stays in p25-p75 range
base.achieves_if_text: earnings trajectory in-line with trend AND multiple stays in p25-p75 range

achieves_if_struct.narrative: earnings trajectory in-line with trend AND multiple stays in p25-p75 range

base.invalidated_if: material earnings surprise (> 10% either side) OR multiple breaks range

bull.achieves_if: forward EPS beats consensus by > 10% AND multiple re-rates to p75 (requires narrative catalyst)
bull.achieves_if_text: forward EPS beats consensus by > 10% AND multiple re-rates to p75 (requires narrative catalyst)

achieves_if_struct.narrative: forward EPS beats consensus by > 10% AND multiple re-rates to p75 (requires narrative catalyst)

bull.invalidated_if: any guidance cut OR macro multiple compression (rates up / recession)

caveats: Multiple range uses company's own 5-year annual history — blind to sector regime shifts
Forward EPS assumes business model continuity (secular disruption breaks all 3 methods)
Earnings quality not adjusted (SBC, one-offs, GAAP vs non-GAAP ignored)
Peer PE blend uses median of up to 5 peers — thin or mismatched peer groups reduce accuracy
Rate adjustment uses DFII10 real rate from fred-macro cache (stale if cache not refreshed)
Signal is advisory only — not a trading instruction
Multiple window: 3 years of annual PE history
